name: Burpee
research: 12 Nov 2026 fix of run 43079162675 (QA: 'end: hands float in front of the body'). Cause 1 (pipeline, fixed in animate.py the same day): the root turn was keyed on the unused quaternion channel (MPFB bones are XYZ euler), so every frame kept the LAST baked lean: the end picture showed the plank's low hips with a standing trunk and the arms stuck out forward. Cause 2 (recipe): toes and hands sat too low. Calibrated from cloud numbers: foot rot X 70 puts the lowest toe point 0.2158 below the ankle (rkc_plank and plank_shoulder_tap both measured -0.0508 at ankle z 0.165), so ankle z 0.218; a knuckle fist on the floor reaches ~0.08 below its grip centre with the arm vertical (plank_shoulder_tap run 43082982264: grip centre 0.081, fists touching), so grip centre z 0.082. Solved with the FK twin of animate.py (arm reach shoulder->grip 0.60 at elbow 5, hip-ankle 0.895 = straight legs on the body line): root rot X 69.1 (body 21 deg above the floor), root z 0.5844 -> shoulders (+-0.22,-0.465,0.681), hips (+-0.11,-0.021,0.538), grip (+-0.22,-0.494,0.082) just ahead of the shoulder (fists under the shoulders), ankle (0.12,0.815,0.218) = hip-ankle 0.895. Arms vertical in the world = elev 68.3, plane 90 in the torso frame; elbow 5 soft, fold toward the head (bend [0,0.34,0.94]). Fists (knuckle plank, press grip axis [-1,0,0]): the rig's hand is a grip, so flat palms are not possible - stated, not hidden. Knee pole below = kneecaps down. Start = standing rest (passed: lowest -0.001). Expected lowest body point at the end: ~0.000 (toes +0.002, fists ~0.00). Facts and checks: research/burpee.json. Sources S1 NASM, S2 Yamashita 2023. 13 Nov 2026 (pics-fixes): the rig now has an open hand: plank hands are FLAT palms (hand 'flat', wrist bent back until the hand is level, arm.flex 'level-'); 'ground' puts both palms and both toe tips on the floor from the real skin (report lows in the stills log). Start hands relaxed (open) at the sides.
